title: RI-05: the rail-yard project and its reward — one track, two stops, one tram carrying the yard's coal to the Depot and the local depot's materials back (the hour bot, rifle off)
setup: river city, seeds 3/4/5, the hour bot on the physical claim path with its west line by tram, rifle off, 75 min; the replay, the 40:00 save, the ledger; the belt route beside it

sections.title: E-project-timeline: the project's moments (mm:ss) — the hour bot on the tram route, rifle off, river city
sections.note: rail-yard-restored: the yard's block Held after the physical claim (the project's commissioning is the claim's Activate); rail-kit-unlocked: the first second Track may be placed; tram-route: the tram on its track; tram-first-delivery: the tram's first unload; rail-coal-arrived: the yard's first coal unit at the Depot (by tram, then the HQ-side belt); depot-supplied / depot-restored: the local depot's materials in its chest, then commissioned at the chest

sections.title: E-project-end: the project records and the hour's end at 75:00
rows: restored · attempt 2 · reward rail-route @ 25:46 · delivered 0 steel, 0 copper

sections.title: E-project-route: the reward as laid — the plan read off the state (hour.ts tramPlan) and its price from the Depot
sections.note: the column is the street between the yard and the HQ nearest the HQ lot that takes it all; stop B (the HQ side) on the row nearest the Depot's, stop A (the yard side) nearest the heap's; the belts by breadth-first search; MACHINE_COST prices (a stop 10 steel, the tram 20 steel + 5 Cu, track 1 steel a tile — implementation defaults, RI-05)

sections.title: E-project-replay: the logged hour replayed on a fresh city — the same state hash, the same project records, the rail kit's lock sampled every tick
sections.note: unlocked at = the first tick Track may be placed; it must equal the restoration's second (the reward is granted once, at the restoration, never before: no circular unlock) and the route must be laid after it; the hash is save.ts stateHash

sections.title: E-project-stages: the rail-yard record's stages through the replay, with the second each began
E-project-save: the replay saved at 40:00 (save.ts makeSave → JSON → loadState), both copies replayed to 75:00 (goalcheck.ts)
sections.note: the goal line's disagreements with its oracle (RI-02's check) are reported here for the tram route, not scored — the oracle knows §11's belt line

sections.title: E-project-ledger: resource conservation (ledger.ts) at the hour's end — opening + sources → held + sinks
sections.note: the tram's cargo and the stops' platforms and arrivals count as held items; the route's kit is a machine price

sections.title: E-project-beside: the tram route against E-hour's belt route (the benchmark configuration, unchanged), rifle off
sections.note: the same city, clock and claims; only the west line differs — the reward's price is what the tram route takes from the Depot that the belt line does not (the belt line: the Excavator and ~15 belts), paid at 26:00 when the chest holds ~18 Cu and no copper comes until the second copper Excavator at 46:00

checks.name: RI-05: the rail yard restored on every seed by the physical claim (an activation attempt id ≥ 0), its reward granted at the restoration's second

RI-05: the reward laid and used — one track, two stops, one tram, and the yard's coal at the Depot by tram on every seed
RI-05 (plan §5.2, §9.1): the local depot's materials rode the tram the other way and the depot was commissioned at its chest on every seed
RI-05: ordinary items only — the platform loads and both projects' requirements are Depot items
RI-05: the logged hour replays to the played run's hash with the same project records and the same tram total (every seed)
RI-05: a save at 40:00 reloads to the same hash and replays to the unbroken run's hash at 75:00 (every seed)
RI-05: every item conserved with the tram's cargo and the stops in the ledger (ledger.ts, tolerance 0.01)
the hour still stands on the tram route: the HQ Held at 75:00 and no block falls (every seed)
the bot's route step is refused nowhere (every placement, take and load went through)
